Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Body, health & movement

heal verb

also cure, curable, heal up, get better (of a wound), treat (a patient), make better, heal a wound, cure (noun), remedy, treat (medically)

classical

Cic. ND 3.70: quam (vomicam) sānāre medicī nōn potuerant (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 61, 63, 64
Traupman 166
Traupman 299
Traupman 327

sānō, sānāre, sānāvī, sānātum

verb, first conjugation

heal, cure

Transitive: the doctor heals the patient or the wound.

Other words

  • sānēscō, sānēscere — get well, heal up

    verb, third conjugation, intransitive · also used · post-classical · Cels. 3.18 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 64; Traupman 327

    Of the wound or the body healing by itself.

  • sānābilis, sānābile — curable

    also used · classical · Ov. Pont. 2.2.59: vulnus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 63; Traupman 299

  • medeor, medērī — heal, be a remedy for

    verb, second conjugation, deponent, with the dative · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 2.44.186: medicō nōn sōlum morbus ejus, cui medērī volet, cognōscendus est (Lewis & Short)

  • cūrō, cūrāre, cūrāvī, cūrātum — treat (a patient)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 19.67: adulēscentēs gravius aegrōtant, tristius cūrantur (Lewis & Short); Traupman 166, 397

  • remedium, remediī n. — a cure, remedy

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cic. ND 2.50.126 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 299

See also recover, treatment, medicine, remedy, doctor.
